Progression to tense bullae with surrounding erythema
Direct immunofluorescence of perilesional skin showing linear deposition of C3 and IgG along the basement membrane zone

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 5 panels (1, 2, 3, 4, 5). 1: Caption explicitly attributes periumbilical erythematous plaques and vesicles to pemphigoid gestationis in G2P1 at 33 weeks gestation; image shows periumbilical urticarial plaques. 2: Caption attributes tense bullae with surrounding erythema to pemphigoid gestationis progression; image shows tense bullae on abdomen. 3: Caption explicitly describes linear C3 and IgG at basement membrane zone on DIF, pathognomonic for pemphigoid gestationis; image shows linear green fluorescence. 4: Caption attributes resolving plaques to later stage pemphigoid gestationis; image still shows visible plaques with hyperpigmentation, representing resolving disease manifestation in same patient. 5: Caption attributes isolated bullous lesion on neonatal auricle to pemphigoid gestationis neonatal involvement; image shows tense bullous lesion, recognized less common neonatal presentation.

panels.figure_caption: Clinical and immunopathologic findings in pemphigoid gestationis. 1 Initial presentation with periumbilical erythematous plaques and vesicles. 2 Progression to tense bullae with surrounding erythema. 3 Direct immunofluorescence of perilesional skin showing linear deposition of C3 and IgG along the basement membrane zone. 4 Later stage with residual hyperpigmentation and resolving plaques. 5 Neonatal involvement with an isolated bullous lesion on the auricle, which resolved spontaneously
in_text_mentions: d gravida 2, para 1 (G2P1) woman at 33 weeks of gestation presented to the emergency department with a pruritic periumbilical rash composed of confluent erythematous patches and sparse vesicles (Fig. 1). The patient denied systemic symptoms, medication use, recent infections, or allergies. She also denied recent travel, fever, or myalgia. Her current pregnancy had been uneventful, and her previous delivery was a full-term spontaneous vaginal birth.Fig. 1Clinical and immunopathologic findings in pemphigoid gestationis. 1 Initial presentation with periumbilical erythematous plaques and vesicles.
